title: Coordinate monotonization
statement: For a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, its monotonization is obtained by successively polarizing in every coordinate, in the order $1,2,\ldots,n$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
